description:
Menjometre is an independent observatory of Catalan public spending. This MCP server gives any LLM client read-only access to the full dataset and the statistical scoring layer built on top of it.  

## Coverage                                                                          
                                                             
  - **~19.5 M** grant records from the Registre d'Ajuts i Subvencions de Catalunya     
  (RAISC), 2016–present                                                                
  - **~1.7 M** public procurement contracts from Dades Obertes de Catalunya          
  - **~496 K** beneficiary entities with normalised identities                         
  - A **public-figure graph** linking Parlament deputies, Generalitat officials, and 
  the boards of publicly-funded entities                                             
  - The **Menjometre score** — a statistical indicator flagging concentration and      
  recurrence patterns in public spending                     
                                                                                       
  ## What the 48 tools cover                                                           
                                                                                       
  | Domain | What you can ask |                                                        
  |---|---|                                                                            
  | `entities` | Search, profile, network, activity timeline for any funded            
  organisation |                                                                     
  | `grants` | RAISC lookups, concentration analysis, purpose trees, year-over-year    
  trends |                                                                           
  | `contractes` | Procurement lookups, sole-source detection, fragmentation patterns |
  | `organs` | Granting-body rankings and profiles |                                 
  | `xarxa` | Public-figure graph, shortest path between two people, cluster           
  investigation |                                                                      
  | `pressupostos` | Generalitat budget surface |                                    
  | `meta` | Methodology, scoring explanation, upstream attribution manifest |         
                                                                                     
  ## Example prompts                                                                   
                                                                                       
  - *"Which ten Catalan entities received the most RAISC funds in 2024?"*              
  - *"Show me the concentration profile of the entity with CIF A08000143."*            
  - *"Which grant-giving bodies award the largest share of their budget to a single    
  beneficiary?"*                                                                       
  - *"What percentage of Ajuntament de Girona's contracts are sole-source?"*           
  - *"Explain how the Menjometre score is computed."*                                  
                                                                                       
  ## Response envelope                                                               
                                                                                       
  Every tool response ships with four things:                                          
                                                                                       
  1. **Attribution** — a `sources` array citing the upstream dataset, licence          
  (CC-BY-4.0 / Llei 37/2007), and publisher                                            
  2. **Scope predicate** — personal-data filters enforced at the database query, not   
  client-side                                                                          
  3. **Framing** — scored responses embed a `score_meta` block with a                  
  `not_an_accusation` disclaimer and a link to the methodology page                  
  4. **Neutral statistical language** — the server returns "top decile", "around the   
  median", never accusatory framing                                                  
                                                                                       
  Safe for journalism, academic research, and civic-tech tooling.                      
                                                                                     
  ## Install via npm                                                                   
                                                                                     
  ```json                                                                              
  {                                                                                  
    "mcpServers": {                                                                    
      "menjometre": {                                                                
        "command": "npx",                                                              
        "args": ["-y", "menjometre-mcp"]                                             
      }                                                                                
    }                                        
  }                                                                                    
                                                                                     
  Also reachable directly over Streamable HTTP at https://www.menjometre.cat/mcp.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_conflict_of_interest
tool_signatures.description: Given a person name and an entity identifier, return every known link (BORME role, political position, declarations, grants received while in office, contracts, lobby meetings).

tool_signatures.name: analyze_contract_network
tool_signatures.description: Contract graph for an organ or entity: sole-source patterns, repeat suppliers, fragmentation signals.

tool_signatures.name: compare_entities
tool_signatures.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 entities (slug or CIF).

tool_signatures.name: detect_clusters
tool_signatures.description: Louvain communities computed nightly. Returns the top clusters by size.

tool_signatures.name: detect_undisclosed_conflicts
tool_signatures.description: Proactive scan: politicians with BORME roles in entities receiving grants/contracts during their term but with no matching declaration.

tool_signatures.name: export_data
tool_signatures.description: Bulk JSON export of grants/contracts/entities with filters. CSV is emitted as plain text for LLM consumption.

tool_signatures.name: fetch_source_document
tool_signatures.description: Server-side retrieval of an allowlisted source URL. Extracts plain text (first 64 kB) via pdf-parse/readability. SSRF-hardened. 24h cached. URL MUST exist in the DB allowlist.

tool_signatures.name: find_shortest_path
tool_signatures.description: Bounded BFS shortest path between two graph nodes. Max depth hard-capped at 5 in the RPC.

tool_signatures.name: get_budget_by_department
tool_signatures.description: Budget series by department with nominal or CPI-deflated (real) values.

tool_signatures.name: get_budget_partides
tool_signatures.description: Line items within a department + year.

tool_signatures.name: get_budget_transfers
tool_signatures.description: Admin → entity transfer flows with filters.

tool_signatures.name: get_dataset_stats
tool_signatures.description: Global counts, EUR totals, and last-sync metadata across grants, contracts, entities, and persons.

tool_signatures.name: get_efficiency_analysis
tool_signatures.description: Cost-per-outcome analysis for selected programmes (EUR spent ÷ outputs where available).

tool_signatures.name: get_ens_public
tool_signatures.description: Instrumental/public body profile including type (consorci, empresa pública, fundació) and parent administration.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity
tool_signatures.description: Full entity profile plus Menjometre scores with natural-language explanations. Accepts slug or CIF. Returns null if entity is anonymised or missing.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_conflicts
tool_signatures.description: Entity-side mirror of conflict detection — politicians linked to the entity.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_contracts
tool_signatures.description: Contracts awarded to the entity with filters (year, min amount, organ, sole-source flag).

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_financials
tool_signatures.description: Yearly financial timeline filed with the Generalitat registry of entities.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_grants
tool_signatures.description: Grants awarded to the entity with filters (year range, min amount, department) and cursor pagination.

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_network
tool_signatures.description: BFS from a single entity up to a max depth (hard-capped at 3).

tool_signatures.name: get_entity_risk_analysis
tool_signatures.description: Aggregated risk dossier: concentration, recurrence, sole-source, fragmentation, dependency, accountability — with textual interpretation per axis.

tool_signatures.name: get_equivalencies
tool_signatures.description: Translate a EUR amount into public-service equivalents (teachers, nurses, daycare places, etc.).

tool_signatures.name: get_fiscal_deficit
tool_signatures.description: Catalonia → Spain fiscal deficit for a year range using one of three academic methods: cash_flow | burden_benefit | contribution_cost.

tool_signatures.name: get_lobby_meetings
tool_signatures.description: Lobby meetings from the Generalitat transparency portal. Filters: official name, interest group, date range.

tool_signatures.name: get_methodology
tool_signatures.description: Scoring methodology, data sources, last-sync timestamps, definitions. Citable for LLM outputs.

tool_signatures.name: get_network_hubs
tool_signatures.description: Highest-degree nodes filtered by type + metric.

tool_signatures.name: get_organ
tool_signatures.description: Single contracting body profile: total contracts, total amount, % sole-source, % menor, % competitive, top-5 suppliers share.

tool_signatures.name: get_party
tool_signatures.description: Party aggregates: member count, total accumulated years, average salary.

tool_signatures.name: get_person_network
tool_signatures.description: BFS from a single person up to a max depth (hard-capped at 3).

tool_signatures.name: get_politica_hub
tool_signatures.description: Global political dashboard: counts by institution, top earners, data coverage, last sync.

tool_signatures.name: get_politician
tool_signatures.description: Profile, accumulated years, party, institution, salary, BORME vincles count.

tool_signatures.name: get_politician_conflicts
tool_signatures.description: Declared + detected conflicts for one politician.

tool_signatures.name: get_politician_salary_history
tool_signatures.description: Detailed salary time-series across positions.

tool_signatures.name: get_porta_giratoria
tool_signatures.description: Revolving door catalog. Filters: party, institution, min years of political service before pivot, sector.

tool_signatures.name: get_pressupostos_hub
tool_signatures.description: Generalitat budget dashboard for a single fiscal year: total, by department, execution rate if available.

tool_signatures.name: get_rankings
tool_signatures.description: Parameterised top-N ranking across entities. `metric` ∈ total_public_funds | menjometre_score | total_grants | total_contracts | sole_source_pct | grant_dependency_pct. Filters: comarca, beneficiary_type, org_type, min_funds.

tool_signatures.name: get_source_documents
tool_signatures.description: Enumerate every source URL attached to a single record. record_type ∈ grant | contract | conveni | politician_position | porta_giratoria_case | personal_eventual_appointment | official_appointment | entity.

tool_signatures.name: get_xarxa_by_comarca
tool_signatures.description: Geographic breakdown of network density (edges per comarca).

tool_signatures.name: get_xarxa_stats
tool_signatures.description: Global network metrics: node counts, edge counts, connectivity, top hubs.

tool_signatures.name: get_yearly_trends
tool_signatures.description: Generic yearly time-series by dimension/metric (grants, contracts, entities).

tool_signatures.name: get_yearly_trends_budget
tool_signatures.description: Generic time-series of a budget dimension/metric (deflated or nominal).

tool_signatures.name: investigate_cluster
tool_signatures.description: Full member list of a Louvain cluster with entity + person joins.

tool_signatures.name: list_carrecs
tool_signatures.description: Positions filtered by institution, party, active status.

tool_signatures.name: list_documents_for_entity
tool_signatures.description: Every source document linked to any record touching the given entity.

tool_signatures.name: list_ens_publics
tool_signatures.description: Instrumental public entities catalog filtered by type/comarca.

tool_signatures.name: list_filter_options
tool_signatures.description: Enumerate all valid filter values the other tools accept: departments, organs, finalitats, parties, comarques, vegueríes, beneficiary types, procedure types.

tool_signatures.name: list_organs
tool_signatures.description: Contracting bodies catalog with filters (semaphore, search) and pagination.

tool_signatures.name: search
tool_signatures.description: Search across entities, politicians, contracts, grants, organs, and persons. Returns top matches with type, name, slug/id, and a short context line.
